library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(matrixStats) 

source("bin/combined_analyses_functions.R")
# read in the data

f_pol <- "../../pop_gen/ref_polymnia/popgen/output_filter_10000/polymnia_filtered_concat.vcf.out.csv.gz"
f_lys <- "../../pop_gen/ref_lysimnia/popgen/output_filter_10000/lysimnia_filtered_concat.vcf.out.csv.gz"

chr_status <- read_csv("tables/chr_status_2026-09-28.csv") %>% rename(chr_status = type)

df <- read_csv(f_pol) %>% mutate(genome = "polymnia")
df_lys <- read_csv(f_lys) %>% mutate(genome = "lysimnia")

df <- df %>% rbind(df_lys) %>%
  rename(pi_polymnia = pi_Mechanitis_polymnia,
         pi_lysimnia = pi_Mechanitis_lysimnia,
         dxy = dxy_Mechanitis_polymnia_Mechanitis_lysimnia,
         fst = Fst_Mechanitis_polymnia_Mechanitis_lysimnia)

df$chr <- clean_chr(df$scaffold)

long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(pi_polymnia, pi_lysimnia, dxy, fst),
               names_to = "stat", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(sites), sites > 0)

summ <- function(d) d %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_windows = n(),
            total_sites     = sum(sites),
            total_value = sum(value*sites) / sum(sites),
            mean      = mean(value),
            median    = median(value),
            sd      = sd(value),
            .groups = "drop")

per_chr <- long %>% group_by(genome, chr, stat) %>% summ()
genome_wide  <- long %>% filter(!chr %in% c("Z", "Z1", "Z2", "W", "W1", "W2")) %>% group_by(genome, stat) %>% summ() %>% mutate(chr = "autosomes")

results <- bind_rows(per_chr, genome_wide) %>% arrange(genome, chr, stat) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(total_value, mean, median, sd), ~ round(.x, 4)))

# total value does not make sense for Fst, so we set it to NA
results <- results %>% mutate(total_value = ifelse(stat %in% c("fst"), NA, total_value))

write_csv(results, "tables/summary_pi_dxy_fst.csv", quote = "needed")
